  cardMarketContent = '## X-Men ''97 Cards: The Nostalgia Explosion

X-Men ''97 cards are among the hottest Marvel cards of 2024. This show single-handedly revived interest in X-Men collecting.',
  keyCards = '- **2024 Upper Deck X-Men ''97 Gambit "Remember It"** — The most emotional MCU moment, $25-60
- **2024 Upper Deck X-Men ''97 Storm** — Goddess moment cards, $15-35
- **2024 Upper Deck X-Men ''97 Complete Set** — Full animated set, $80-150
- **1992 Impel X-Men Series 1 Gambit** — Vintage card that spiked after Episode 5, $20-50+',
  content = '## The Show That Saved Marvel

X-Men ''97 arrived at a time when Marvel fatigue was at its peak — and reminded everyone why they fell in love with superheroes in the first place. With a 99% critics score on Rotten Tomatoes, it became the highest-rated MCU project ever and proved that great storytelling transcends medium, budget, or franchise fatigue.

## Episode 5: "Remember It"

The Genosha massacre episode is one of the most devastating hours of television in superhero history. Gambit''s sacrifice — "I can''t feel you, chere" — broke the internet and sent Gambit card values through the roof. It was the moment that proved animated shows could hit harder than any movie.

## Storm''s Goddess Moment

Storm''s journey from powerless to reclaiming her abilities with the declaration "I am a goddess" was one of the most triumphant character moments in MCU history. Alison Sealy-Smith''s voice performance was legendary, and Storm cards from this era became instant collector items.

## Fun Facts

- The show has a 99% critics score, the highest of any MCU project
- Gambit card values tripled overnight after Episode 5 aired
- Most original voice actors from the 1990s series returned
- The show was renewed for Season 2 before Season 1 finished airing
- Beau DeMayo was fired mid-season but his scripts were used for the remaining episodes',
  metaDescription = 'X-Men ''97 (2024) guide — the highest-rated MCU project, Gambit sacrifice, Storm goddess moment, trading card market explosion, and why this show saved Marvel.',
  keywords = 'x-men 97, gambit, storm, wolverine, animated, disney plus marvel, marvel cards, remember it, genosha, 99 percent',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck X-Men 97 Gambit Storm cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is X-Men ''97 connected to the MCU?","answer":"Yes, X-Men ''97 exists within the MCU multiverse. The show is a continuation of the 1990s animated series and is considered canon to the broader Marvel multiverse."},{"question":"Do I need to watch the original 1990s X-Men series first?","answer":"While not strictly required, watching the original series (or at least knowing its major plot points) significantly enhances the experience as X-Men ''97 directly continues those storylines."},{"question":"Why did Gambit cards spike in value?","answer":"Episode 5 featured Gambit''s heroic sacrifice during the Genosha massacre, creating one of the most emotional moments in MCU history. The cultural impact sent vintage and new Gambit card values soaring overnight."}]',
  status = 'published'
WHERE slug = 'x-men-97-2024';

UPDATE mcu_media SET
  director = 'Jac Schaeffer, Gandja Monteiro, Rachel Goldberg',
  `cast` = 'Kathryn Hahn as Agatha Harkness, Joe Locke as Teen / Billy Maximoff, Sasheer Zamata as Jennifer Kale, Ali Ahn as Alice Wu-Gulliver, Debra Jo Rupp as Sharon Davis, Patti LuPone as Lilia Calderu, Aubrey Plaza as Rio Vidal / Death',
  tagline = 'The road is long. The coven is ready. Agatha''s witchy road trip down the Witches'' Road.',
  description = 'Agatha All Along follows Agatha Harkness as she assembles a coven of witches to travel the dangerous Witches'' Road, a magical gauntlet that promises to restore what each witch has lost, while a mysterious Teen harbors secrets about his true identity.',
  imageUrl = 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310419663027009739/SGHqXeh8PZJcCDnFiAMuFi/agatha-all-along-featured-6RUAhxPPXLEKmCJJUjGD8E.webp',
  episodeCount = 9, seasonCount = 1, platform = 'Disney+',
  rtCriticsScore = 84, rtAudienceScore = 63, verdict = 'hit',
  cardMarketContent = '## Agatha All Along Cards: The Wiccan Premium

Agatha All Along cards are valuable primarily for the Billy Maximoff/Wiccan reveal. Joe Locke''s Teen being confirmed as Wanda''s son Billy makes those cards essential for Young Avengers collectors. Kathryn Hahn''s continued popularity and Aubrey Plaza as Death add star power to the set.',
  keyCards = '- **2025 Upper Deck Agatha All Along Billy/Wiccan Reveal** — Young Avengers key card, $15-35
- **2025 Upper Deck Agatha Kathryn Hahn** — Fan-favorite character card, $8-20
- **2025 Upper Deck Agatha Aubrey Plaza/Rio Vidal** — Death personified card, $10-25
- **2025 Upper Deck Agatha Patti LuPone** — Broadway legend in MCU, $5-12',
  content = '## The Witches'' Road

Agatha All Along took the WandaVision spinoff in an unexpected direction — a witchy road trip horror-comedy that felt more like a dark fairy tale than a superhero show. Each trial on the Witches'' Road tested a different witch''s abilities and fears, creating an episodic structure that kept the show fresh.

## Billy Maximoff Lives

The show''s biggest revelation — that Joe Locke''s "Teen" was actually Billy Maximoff, Wanda''s reincarnated son — set up the Young Avengers'' future. His journey from confused teenager to accepting his identity as Wiccan was the show''s emotional backbone.

## Aubrey Plaza as Death

Aubrey Plaza playing the literal personification of Death — disguised as Agatha''s love interest Rio Vidal — was inspired casting. Her chemistry with Kathryn Hahn crackled with centuries of history, and the reveal added cosmic weight to what seemed like a small-scale story.

## Fun Facts

- The "Agatha All Along" theme song from WandaVision was expanded into a full musical number
- Patti LuPone (Broadway legend) brought genuine theatrical gravitas to Lilia
- The show confirmed that Wanda''s children can reincarnate, setting up Wiccan and Speed
- Aubrey Plaza reportedly lobbied hard for the role of Rio/Death
- The Witches'' Road trials were inspired by classic fairy tale structures',
  metaDescription = 'Agatha All Along (2024) guide — Witches'' Road breakdown, Billy Maximoff/Wiccan reveal, Aubrey Plaza as Death, trading card values, and WandaVision spinoff analysis.',
  keywords = 'agatha all along, kathryn hahn, billy maximoff, wiccan, aubrey plaza, death, witches road, disney plus marvel, marvel cards',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Agatha All Along Wiccan cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Do I need to watch WandaVision before Agatha All Along?","answer":"Yes, Agatha All Along is a direct spinoff of WandaVision. Understanding Agatha''s imprisonment and the Scarlet Witch''s story is essential context."},{"question":"Who is Teen/Billy Maximoff?","answer":"Teen is revealed to be Billy Maximoff, the reincarnated son of Wanda Maximoff (Scarlet Witch). He is also known as Wiccan in the comics and is expected to be a key member of the Young Avengers."}]',
  status = 'published'
WHERE slug = 'agatha-all-along-2024'
